messages:
noah: Heads-up: enterprise pilot A asked for a short, prescriptive checklist for launching with regional routing + tenant isolation. They want clear breakpoints for "go/no-go". Can someone build a buyer-friendly checklist we can hand to AMs? @tara

tara: I can. Suggest we split into: (1) Service guarantees (latency/cost), (2) Isolation & residency constraints, (3) Operational safety (fallbacks/evacuation), (4) Validation tests. Keep it 6-8 bullets.

jovi: Ops/infra input: include an "acceptable spillover" threshold (percent of traffic allowed cross-region) and a required burst buffer (X% of peak). Also add "KV cache evac time" objective.

mike: Product note: don't promise p99 numbers for beta. Use p50 targets and a p99 stability margin statement. Also include supported model variants list (quantized / non-quantized).

noah: Draft snippet for AMs below. Short, checklist style. Will post to pilot channel after edits.

noah: ```text
Launch checklist (pilot-ready):
1) SLA bucket: Gold/Silver/Beta (declare expected p50 latency and cost per 1k tokens)
2) Residency: Regions allowed / blocked (legal sign-off if cross-region fallback permitted)
3) Isolation mode: Shared / Dedicated / Quarantine; quota & QoS limits set
4) Failover order: safe_model_variant -> local_region -> dedicated_capacity -> degrade_to-stub
5) Safety gates: prompt-set regression <5% failures on smoke tests
6) Ops controls: cost-cap, autoscale burn-rate alert, manual-evacuation playbook
7) Telemetry: token-cost, p50/p90/p99, error-rate, kv-evac-time metric
8) Rollback plan: canary window + immediate-route-to-safe_variant
```

tara: Love it. Add one line: "Pilot customers must agree to test windows for controlled failover."

jovi: Adding runbook step: "on evacuation -> pause new sessions, drain active KV windows, spin up dedicated variant, verify warm cache".

mike: We'll attach a one-page model-compat table and a short note on expected unit-cost delta for dedicated vs shared. Keeps sales expectations aligned.

ci-bot: CI: doc lint passed: infra/pilot-checklist.md (1 file changed)

noah: OK — I'll finalize and send to AMs. Plan: publish to pilots tomorrow morning, follow-up sync with ops next week to run the burn-rate test. If any objections, reply ASAP. :rocket:
